DIAGNOSIS READY: Viral Hepatitis A.

The combination of your recent fair attendance, three weeks of fatigue and fever, dark urine, and abdominal pain strongly suggests a viral hepatitis infection. The dark urine is likely due to bilirubin excretion rather than dehydration, especially given your history of diabetes. Given the 3-week timeline, I am confident this is not an acute food poisoning issue but rather a subacute liver inflammation. I will proceed with the diagnosis of Hepatitis A based on the classic presentation of jaundice precursors (dark urine) and systemic symptoms following a high-risk exposure.
